# Concept

- Average value is $$E[Y|D=1]=\int Y f(Y|M,D=1,Z)dY f(M,Z|D=1)dMdZ$$ $$=\int Y f(Y|M,D=1,Z)dY f(M|Z,D=1)f(Z|D=1)dMdZ$$

- Interest counterfactual is $$\theta=\int Y f(Y|M,D=1,Z)dY f(M|Z,D=0)f(Z)dMdZ$$

- Required weight is $$f(M,Z|D=1)\omega(M,Z)=f(M|Z,D=0)f(Z)$$ $$\omega(M,Z)=\frac{f(M,Z|D=0)f(Z)}{f(M,Z|D=1)f(Z|D=0)}$$

## Balancing weght

$$\omega(X) f(X|D=1)=f(X)$$

$$\omega(X) f(X|D=1)=f(X|D=d)$$
